title: Practice 2: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural: работал, работала, работало, работали. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural: работал, работала, работало, работали.

exercises.prompt: Go to the barbershop.
exercises.why: Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.* b) Prefix "с-" implying a single round trip: сходить, съездить, слетать. These verbs denote a single trip (going to and coming from a place), especially when a quick return is implied. *Мне надо сходить на почту за письмами. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.* b) Prefix "с-" implying a single round trip: сходить, съездить, слетать.

exercises.prompt: Drop everything and get over here.
exercises.why: The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs. It is formed from the 3rd person plural of the present tense or the perfective future by dropping the ending (-ют, -ут, -ят, -ат) and adding the endings of the imperative: — DLI, Lessons 42 and 84.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.
